reports.title: SBA Communications Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results;

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The Company’s full year 2026 Outlook assumes the acquisitions of only those communication sites under contract which are expected to close in 2026 at the time of this press release. The Company may spend additional capital in 2026 on acquiring revenue producing assets not yet identified or under contract, the impact of which is not reflected in the 2026 Outlook. The 2026 Outlook also does not contemplate any additional repurchases of the Company’s stock or additional debt financings during the remainder of 2026 (other than the refinancing of the 2021-1C Tower Securities as discussed below), although the Company may ultimately spend capital to repurchase stock or issue new debt during the remainder of the year.

The Company’s 2026 Outlook assumes an average foreign currency exchange rate of 5.32 Brazilian Reais to 1.0 U.S. Dollar, 2,560 Tanzanian Shillings to 1.0 U.S. Dollar, and 16.40 South African Rand to 1.0 U.S. Dollar for the fourth quarter of 2026.

The sale of the Company’s towers and related assets held in Chile and Ecuador negatively impacted the 2026 full year Outlook by approximately $10.0 million for Site leasing revenue, $6.0 million for Tower Cash Flow, and $4.0 million for Adjusted EBITDA.
